player_prompt.intro:
Kedda d-ikkes {player_id} di SimpleTak.
Di essuf, idaw-ennek tifinagh '{player_stone}' ed idaw-en uɣent-ik '{opponent_stone}'.

Di tawalt-ik, xtar cell wahd (s uṭṭun-is) ed ssekcem idaw-ennek dinna.
Ala tallalt, '[12]' issekcem idaw-ennek di cell 12.

Tawalt-ik d assaɣer aɣelluy n idaw-ennek iqqennuɣen tirew sakin iɣelluy n essuf (sakin-ufella nɣ sakin-ayfus).
